pre_registered_outcomes.P1: dev-5 first-turn hypotheses blaming citations, labels or evidence ids (checker v2 claim match confirmed by a person): pass if GUIDE <= 4 of 40 and CONTROL >= 20 of 40; CONTROL < 20 of 40 is UNINFORMATIVE.
pre_registered_outcomes.P2: dev-5 first-attempt validity in GUIDE not lower than CONTROL by more than 5 of 40; over-600 count not higher by more than 5 of 40.
pre_registered_outcomes.P3: counts and a one-sided Fisher test, no pass bar: valid non-null requests; C3 and C5 naming by the written rubric; dev-6 naming C4 rather than o3.
pre_registered_outcomes.P4: repair turns returning a valid answer with a hypothesis of at most 600 characters: pass if at least 9 of 10 on each setup with the Rule 1 message; today's message measured as the baseline.
pre_registered_outcomes.decision_rule: Rule 1 ships unless P4 shows the new message is worse than today's; Rule 2 ships only if P1 and P2 pass.
